query: Получай курсы валют с https://api.exchangerate.host/latest и сохраняй результат в файл /data/output/rates.json.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: currency_rates_pipeline
  name: Currency Rates Fetch and Save
  description: Fetch latest currency rates from exchangerate.host and save to /data/output/rates.json
triggers:
- id: trigger_manual
  type: manual
  condition: on demand
sources:
- id: source_exchangerate
  name: ExchangeRate API
  type: HTTP
  location: https://api.exchangerate.host/latest
  connection:
    properties:
      method: GET
processing_elements: []
sinks:
- id: sink_file_rates
  name: Rates JSON File
  type: File
  location: /data/output/rates.json
  connection:
    properties:
      format: json
processed_data:
- id: rates_json
  format: json
links:
- from_id: source_exchangerate
  to_id: sink_file_rates
  data_ref: rates_json

error.details:
Trigger(s) ['trigger_manual'] have type 'manual'.
The flow will NOT start automatically in NiFi — someone must press Run in the NiFi UI.
Change trigger type to 'schedule' or 'event' for production use.
